freehire_directory.caveat: Mutable paged directory, not an atomic provider export; targeted current identity queries also required.

notes: Explicit maintainer instruction authorizes publication; no auto-merge is enabled.
PPD has separate French and English inventories, both included.

Leclerc English and US editions have identical 30 requisition IDs. Its French edition has 20 IDs; the union contains 42 IDs. Eight bilingual requisitions appear in both authored language monitors; source-record counts are not unique vacancy counts.
Marmen Canadian and US careers pages both publish the same explicit ADP board. French and English API reads returned the same six US roles; no Canadian openings are claimed.
ASP was excluded after the alias A.S.P. Incorporated matched FreeHire and its exact JazzHR job URLs.
Groupe Bellemare was rejected because both language listings publish undefined titles; no placeholder roles were accepted.
No page, role, title, country or detail-count cap was introduced. Failed optional description enrichment remains visible in monitor warnings.
